queries.question: For each product category, calculate total revenue after discounts, using price times quantity times one minus discount, and identify the category with the highest revenue.
queries.sql_query:
SELECT c.category_name, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
queries.final_answer:

queries.question: Show the month-by-month revenue trend after discounts based on order date.
queries.sql_query:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS Year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS Month, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS Revenue
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY Year, Month
ORDER BY Year, Month;
queries.final_answer:
